correctness.rationale: Every realized nonconstant binary cyclic profile has parameters n,z,t; marking one of its t indexed 01 transitions and counting alternating positive compositions yields n/t * C(z-1,t-1)*C(n-z-1,t-1). For fixed t>=2 its consecutive z-ratio has cleared difference (t-1)(n-2z-1), so centered content strictly dominates; for n>=6 centered t=2 dominates all t=1 profiles. For fixed centered content the adjacent t-ratio equals (z-t)(n-z-t)/(t(t+1)); its sign relative to 1 is the sign of z(n-z)-t(n+1). Modulo-four evaluation proves the four formulae and exact maximizing sets. Small n are directly resolved. Stirling gives uniform asymptotic constant 4/pi. Python parameter search n<=200, direct word enumeration n<=19, and separate C++17 four-entry matrix census n<=20 replayed successfully. These checks supplement a self-contained infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed novelty is the explicit all-length largest inverse list and complete maximizing pair profiles, including a transition-count tie when n is 1 modulo 4 and the exact 4/pi asymptotic. Jacquet et al. count the number of Markov types, whereas Whittle and run-statistics methods address individual cardinalities or marginal distributions; a separate global optimization and strict equality analysis are required. Related linear multispectrum results concern different observations and other invariants. Historical priority is qualified, particularly where older full text was inaccessible.
residual_risks: Whittle (1955) and Inoue–Aki (2010) full primary texts were inaccessible; older joint-count formulas are known and may contain an unobserved exact global optimization.
No search coverage can prove priority, and an unindexed circular runs table or wider theorem could explicitly include the four-residue maximal inverse-list classification.

value.rationale: The exact maximum list size of the noiseless cyclic two-gram observation is a canonical worst-case reconstruction invariant and determines maximum conditional ambiguity, unlike the number of distinct outputs or a single fixed type. The all-length equality structure is parity-sensitive: every maximizing input has balanced symbol content, and n congruent to 1 mod 4 has two maximizing run budgets. The explicit 4/pi constant quantifies a worst list of order 2^n/n. This is a genuine global extremal classification, not only a known-table recomputation or finite trial.
